answer: Pay an answer by how lopsided its verdict was, not just whether it passed. A 5-0 pass pays in full, 4-1 pays 70%, and 3-2 pays just 25%, with the rest rolling into next epoch's pool. Solid work like a bridge load report or a crystal oscillator spec usually wins 5-0 or 4-1 anyway, so honest authors barely feel it. A farm holding 20% of graders can sometimes grab 3 seats and squeak a junk terrace drainage plan through, but that's a 3-2 at a quarter pay. Full pay needs all 5 seats, which at 20% happens about 3 times in 10,000 panels.
